params.prompt: The character in <Picture 1> jogs forward at a steady, moderate running pace (a light jog, faster than walking, with a brief flight phase where both feet are off the ground) in a continuous, looping jog cycle, seen in strict side view (profile), facing left. The camera tracks alongside like a treadmill shot so the character stays centered; the full body from the top of the hood to the feet is always in frame and the feet are always visible. Each stride: a blade foot plants on the ground under the body, the backward-bending hock compresses, the leg pushes off strongly and the knee drives forward. Arms bent, swinging opposite to the legs, slight forward lean. Keep exactly the same character design: chainmail mesh hood over a pale face, dark rust-stained armoured torso, black box backpack, wide boxy rust-orange armoured thigh plates down to the knee, and DIGITIGRADE mechanical legs: thin dark shins that slant backward from the knee to a raised hock, and feet made of three long curved blade tines forming a backward hook whose tips touch the ground. Plain neutral grey seamless studio background, even soft studio lighting, realistic 3D render, no other objects, no text.
